summary: Futurism reported BuzzFeed announced layoffs of 180 employees, about one-third of its remaining workforce, in the latest sign of its decline since the company's pivot to AI.
evidenceQuote: On Monday, the struggling media company announced the layoffs of 180 employees, or about a third of its entire workforce, in the latest sign of its decline since its unexpected pivot to AI.
notes: Included as a weaker AI-related media lead. Futurism links the layoffs to BuzzFeed's post-AI-pivot decline and broader media pressure from AI, while the cited memo also frames the cuts as cost management and role eliminations across the company.
